body.condition: \(S_{t+1}\perp M_t\mid(H_t^F,A_t,R_t)\) for every \(t\in\mathcal T\); on all cells, including zero-mass conditioning cells, this means the polynomial equations \(q_t(h,a,r,1,s)q_t(h,a,r,0,s')=q_t(h,a,r,0,s)q_t(h,a,r,1,s')\) for every \(h\in\mathcal H_t^F\), \(a\in\mathcal A\), \(r\in\mathcal R\), and \(s,s'\in\mathcal S\).

novel.justification: A temporal structural causal model satisfies the restriction when, conditional on the complete latent past, current action, and current reward, the recording mechanism and next-state innovation have independent disturbances and recording has no causal effect on the next state. This describes delayed administrative recording or passive sensor dropout that does not alter care after conditioning on the complete clinical history.
